research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12601 (52 FR 24129, PDF pages 11-12 of the 1987-06-29 issue; sha256 4fd6a328...), headed Executive Order 12601 of June 24, 1987, Presidential Commission on the Human Immunodeficiency Virus Epidemic, matching the census register row (1987-06-24). Text and inventory: the machine inventory has ten clauses and omits section 1(a), the establishing sentence (the first inventoried clause is section 1(b)); I corrected the inventory by adding section 1(a) (characters 1146-1611 of the registered text) and kept the other spans. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: Executive Order 12692 section 3(g) revokes Executive Order 12601 as amended by Executive Order 12603, effective September 30, 1989 (section 5). The report deadlines in section 2(d) and the report-relative termination in section 4(b) are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12692 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the Presidential Commission on the Human Immunodeficiency Virus Epidemic: its section 1 continues other committees, its section 2 reassigns Federal Advisory Committee Act functions only for those other committees, and its section 3 revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the Commission.
